turns.text:
2:38 am update. typing one-handed, sorry. can you tighten this text to my wife? it's rambly but i don't want to lose the info. please keep my tone

"hey, so the crossover was great for the drive to Delgado Park today, Theo slept the whole way in the car seat and the stroller fit in the trunk with room to spare. scoreboard: dad 1, hatchback 0. crib naps held at 9, 12:30 and 4 even on the weekend, which i'm choosing to believe is because of my genius. i added like six lighthouse pieces to the puzzle during the 12:30 nap, so that's basically a career. this week: Tuesday and Friday are baby laundry nights, i'll do the grocery list tomorrow. also i'll take the early feed tomorrow, you just sleep. Sunday errands: dry cleaning, pharmacy, diapers. i can do all of it with Theo in the carrier, no need for you to think about it"

Here's a tighter version that keeps your tone:

"Crossover report: great drive to Delgado Park, Theo slept the whole way in the car seat, and the stroller fit in the trunk with room to spare. Scoreboard: dad 1, hatchback 0. Crib naps held at 9, 12:30 and 4 even on the weekend, which I'm choosing to credit to my genius. I also added six lighthouse pieces to the puzzle during the 12:30 nap, so basically a career.

This week: baby laundry Tuesday and Friday nights, and I'll do the grocery list tomorrow. I'll take the early feed tomorrow, so you just sleep. Sunday errands: dry cleaning, pharmacy, diapers. I've got all of it, Theo in the carrier, nothing for you to think about."

I trimmed the repeated phrases and tightened the sentence breaks. One note: your draft says "tomorrow" for the early feed and the grocery list, but you're writing at 2:38 a.m. Sunday, so you may want to say "tonight" or a specific day so it's clear. Want a shorter, three-line version too?
yes the short version please, it's almost 3 and my brain is toast. also good catch on tomorrow, it's already sunday lol, so make the early feed "this morning"

Short version:

"Crossover verdict: great drive to Delgado Park, Theo slept the whole way, stroller fits with room to spare. Dad 1, hatchback 0. Crib naps held at 9, 12:30 and 4, and I added six lighthouse pieces to the puzzle. I'll take the early feed this morning, so sleep in. Errands today: dry cleaning, pharmacy, diapers. I've got it, Theo in the carrier. Laundry Tuesday and Friday nights, groceries list coming."

Go get some sleep, and good luck with the early feed.
